final: WITH per_film AS (SELECT rating, replacement_cost * 1.0 / rental_rate AS ratio FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate <> 0 AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL), per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, o.overall_avg FROM per_rating p JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE p.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_per_rating_averages, AVG(avg_ratio - overall_avg) AS avg_difference_from_overall FROM kept
